title: Orbit Configuration
description: Configuration file for orbit, a modern cron that uses systemd as its back-end.

include.description: Other TOML config files to merge into this one. Paths are relative to this file. A leading '?' makes an include optional; '*' is the only glob wildcard and may match zero files. Included files may only define tasks and reminders.

tasks.description: Task definitions. Each key is the task name.

reminders.description: Reminder definitions. Each key is the reminder name.

schedule.description: systemd OnCalendar expression (e.g. 'daily', '*-*-* 03:00:00'). Omit for manual-only tasks.

on_missed.description: Behavior when a scheduled run was missed. Only valid when schedule is set.

attempts.description: Number of retry attempts. Set to 0 to disable retries. Defaults to 3 if omitted.

if_failed.description: Hook that runs when the task command has failed after all retries. Receives ORBIT_TASK, ORBIT_EXIT_CODE, ORBIT_ATTEMPTS, ORBIT_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES, ORBIT_FAILED_CYCLES and ORBIT_DURATION_MS in its environment.

after.description: Number of consecutive failed retry cycles before the hook fires. Defaults to 1 (every failed cycle).

reminder.description: A recurring reminder with optional condition check.

command.description: Optional command to run when the reminder is acknowledged.

check.description: Optional command to run before firing. The reminder only triggers if this command exits with code 0.
